hypothesis: A source-checked, explicitly inventoried FAQ identity can support incremental bilingual edits and safe duplicate refusal without free-form semantic approval.
scope: Optional in-memory owned-fixture Markdown editor; one written-integer-return question kind, closed Python/Go facts; all original bytes retained.
input_authority: Operator declares complete FAQ inventory and owned insertion/claim markers in isolated fixtures; arbitrary prose is not automatically indexed or adopted.
rules: ADD a missing inventoried FAQ from a positively observed current integer-return body, including an already-existing feature. This is a FAQ addition, not proof of a newly added source feature.
MODIFY only a checksum-bound owned FAQ with admitted bilingual text and a contradictory current integer return.
REMOVE only with positive current retirement evidence accepted by the lifecycle engine, complete declared scope and no alias/relocation ambiguity.
NO-OP must retain exact input document bytes.
Duplicate canonical question identities, human content conflicts, stale hashes, missing inventory, unsupported prose or incomplete source imply INCONCLUSIVE without edits.
Question deduplication is registry-identity based; no claim of arbitrary paraphrase detection.
Original files are never written; changing candidates carry original history bytes, exact diff and owner_approved false.
evaluation_partition: Synthetic development controls plus new independent project-family source examples when supported; no generated gold or certified holdout.
